findings.claim: Current regression at the hand-write rewrite: PY_OPEN_WRITE requires a positional mode quote, so open('AGENTS.md', mode='w') and Path('src/app.py').open('w') are not path-bearing write matches, where the base PY_WRITE+PY_PATH pair matched the same text. Slice contract 1 says a code-root path is a write when the statement's verb writes that path; keyword-mode open is that verb. The requested data/read exceptions (open('/tmp/x','w') writing the lane path as data; Path.read_text of a lane path) do not require dropping those ordinary write spellings. Impact: the PreToolUse hand-write row no longer classifies those Bash-Python spellings, so the freeze does not deny them; Write/Edit tools and positional open('AGENTS.md','w') / Path('src/app.py').write_text still deny. P2 not P1 under D-LAUNCHER-1 (ratified 2026-09-04: private repo, workers are the lane's harnesses in snapshots): this is a lost ordinary guard at a changed decision point, not a demonstrated file mutation and not an outside-contributor exploit. Unexecuted reproduction hypothesis: matrix.check_text of python3 -c "open('AGENTS.md', mode='w').write('x')" returns None. Support boundary, same concern not a second defect: a variable-bound Path('ops/foo.py') then p.write_text is also unmatched.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c "import re,pathlib; s=pathlib.Path('ops/devlane/hooks/claude/matrix.py').read_text(); o=re.search(r'PY_OPEN_WRITE = re\\.compile\\(\\n    r\"(.*?)\"\\n\\)',s).group(1); p=re.search(r'PY_PATH_WRITE = re\\.compile\\(\\n    r\"(.*?)\"\\n    r\"(.*?)\"\\n\\)',s); O=re.compile(o); W=re.compile(p.group(1)+p.group(2)); pos=\"open(\'AGENTS.md\',\'w\').write(\'x\')\"; kw=\"open(\'AGENTS.md\', mode=\'w\').write(\'x\')\"; print('pos',bool(O.search(pos)),'kw',bool(O.search(kw)),'pathopen',bool(W.search(\"Path(\'src/app.py\').open(\'w\')\")))"

findings.claim: Current regression at dispatch_args: kind is taken only from base(tokens[0]), replacing the base tokens[:3] scan. python3 ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py and /usr/bin/env python3 .../launch.py therefore stop classifying as launcher, while pgrep -fc launch.py correctly stops classifying. Slice contract 2 and the PR reviewer note require refusing launch.py as the command word and allowing those pgrep argument forms; they do not require dropping interpreter invocation. AGENTS.md:97-98 still requires dispatch.sh or go.sh and nothing else, with in-session sub-agents refused by this hook. Impact: check_dispatch's direct-launch deny does not fire on interpreter-launched launch.py; this is a lost required guard visible in the diff, not a demonstrated unauthorized dispatch. P2 not P1 under D-LAUNCHER-1: do not overclaim that python3 launch.py completes a policy bypass. Spec ambiguity on 'command word' versus argv0 is resolved against AGENTS.md and the matrix docstring (launch.py run without the dispatcher), not as a slice-intentional tradeoff. Bounded correction: keep the pgrep exception; restore launcher recognition when launch.py is the executed program.

Current composition gap at clipped-sweep: SWEEP_CLIPPED is '| head -N' only. Slice contract 3 keeps | head and skips | tail; the named BLOCK row | tail -10 correctly stops matching SWEEP_CLIPPED, and | head -8 / | head -5 still match. POSIX head -n N never matched CLIPPED either (pre-existing incompleteness for a head-only sweep). Newly unclassified: an allowed tail followed by head -n, e.g. grep -E 'alpha|beta|gamma' docs/README.md | tail -10 | head -n 5, because the old CLIPPED match on | tail -10 is gone and SWEEP_CLIPPED does not see -n. The sibling | tail -10 | head -5 still matches SWEEP_CLIPPED. Impact: a multi-alternation grep can be silently truncated by a following POSIX head after an allowed tail, contrary to keep | head. P2 under D-LAUNCHER-1: this is the hook's completeness-guard function at the changed site, not an outside exploit. Unexecuted reproduction hypothesis: unsafe_command.check of that pipeline returns None. Bounded correction: recognize head -n N, or do not let a skipped tail hide a following head; do not re-block tail-alone.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c "import re,pathlib; s=pathlib.Path('ops/devlane/hooks/claude/unsafe-command.py').read_text(); C=re.compile(re.search(r'^CLIPPED = re\\.compile\\(r\"(.*?)\"\\)',s,re.M).group(1)); S=re.compile(re.search(r'^SWEEP_CLIPPED = re\\.compile\\(r\"(.*?)\"\\)',s,re.M).group(1)); cmd=\"grep -E 'alpha|beta|gamma' docs/README.md | tail -10 | head -n 5\"; print('SWEEP_CLIPPED',re.search(r'^SWEEP_CLIPPED = .*',s,re.M).group(0)); print('composition CLIPPED',bool(C.search(cmd)),'SWEEP',bool(S.search(cmd))); h=\"grep -E 'a|b|c' f | head -n 5\"; print('head-n-only CLIPPED',bool(C.search(h)),'SWEEP',bool(S.search(h)))"
